reproduce the results: Other scientists tried to reproduce the results of the experiment but got very different numbers.
其他科學家試圖重現這個實驗的結果，卻得到非常不同的數據。
reproduce a painting: Modern printers can reproduce a painting so well that it is hard to tell the copy from the original.
現代印表機能把畫作複製得非常逼真，很難分辨複製品和原作。
animals reproduce: Most animals reproduce in spring, when there is plenty of food for their babies.
大多數動物在春天繁殖，因為那時有充足的食物給牠們的寶寶。
reproduce the conditions: In the lab, scientists reproduce the conditions found deep under the sea to study strange fish.
在實驗室裡，科學家重建深海中的條件，以研究奇特的魚類。
request permission: Students must request permission from the teacher before leaving the classroom during a test.
考試期間，學生離開教室前必須向老師請求許可。
request a refund: The shoes broke after only two days, so I went back to the store to request a refund.
這雙鞋才穿兩天就壞了，所以我回到店裡要求退款。
at one's request: At her request, the hotel moved her to a quieter room facing the garden instead of the busy street.
應她的要求，飯店把她換到一間面向花園、而非熱鬧街道的安靜房間。
upon request: Vegetarian meals are available upon request, so please tell the flight attendant before takeoff.
素食餐點可應要求提供，所以請在起飛前告知空服員。
request that: The students request that the school library stay open until nine o'clock during exam week.
學生們要求學校圖書館在考試週開放到晚上九點。
require patience: Teaching young children to read and write can require patience, love, and a lot of time.
教幼童讀書寫字可能需要耐心、愛心和大量時間。
be required by law: In Taiwan, wearing a helmet while riding a scooter is required by law for everyone.
在台灣，騎機車時戴安全帽是法律規定每個人都必須做的。
require students to: Many high schools in Taiwan require students to wear uniforms and arrive before 7:30 every morning.
台灣許多高中要求學生穿制服，並且每天早上七點半前到校。
require attention: The roof of this old house is leaking, so it will require attention before the typhoon comes.
這棟老房子的屋頂在漏水，所以颱風來之前需要關注處理。
required reading: This novel is required reading for all first-year students, so every one of them must buy a copy.
這本小說是所有一年級學生的必讀書目，所以每個人都必須買一本。
rescue a company: The new boss managed to rescue a company that had been losing millions of dollars every year.
新老闆成功拯救了一家每年虧損數百萬元的公司。
rescue the situation: Just when the concert seemed ruined, the singer's sister rushed on stage to rescue the situation.
就在演唱會似乎要搞砸時，歌手的姊姊衝上台挽救局面。
rescue hostages: Special police officers broke into the bank to rescue hostages held by the armed robbers.
特警衝進銀行，解救被武裝搶匪挾持的人質。
come to the rescue: When my car broke down on the highway, a kind truck driver came to the rescue and fixed it.
我的車在高速公路上拋錨時，一位好心的卡車司機前來救援並修好了車。
rescue a plan: Our class trip was almost canceled, but the teacher found a cheaper bus company and managed to rescue a plan we had worked hard on.
我們的班級旅行差點取消，但老師找到更便宜的遊覽車公司，成功挽救了我們努力籌備的計畫。
research the topic: Before writing your report, you should research the topic carefully using books and trusted websites.
寫報告之前，你應該利用書籍和可靠的網站仔細研究這個主題。
research the market: Before opening her café, Lisa decided to research the market to find out what customers wanted.
開咖啡廳之前，Lisa 決定先做市場調查，了解顧客想要什麼。
research a book: The author lived in Tainan for six months to research a book about the city's long history.
這位作家在台南住了六個月，為寫一本關於這座城市悠久歷史的書做研究。
research into: Scientists are doing more research into new ways to fight cancer and help patients live longer.
科學家正在針對對抗癌症的新方法進行更多研究，幫助病人活得更久。
resemble one's father: As he grows older, Jack begins to resemble his father more and more, especially when he smiles.
隨著年紀增長，Jack 長得越來越像父親，尤其是笑的時候。
closely resemble: These fake bags closely resemble the real ones, so many tourists are fooled into buying them.
這些仿冒包和真品非常相像，所以許多觀光客被騙而買下。
resemble each other: The two sisters resemble each other so much that even their teachers often mix them up.
這兩姊妹彼此非常相似，連老師都常常把她們搞混。
reserve a table: Let's reserve a table at the restaurant for Friday night, because it is always crowded on weekends.
我們來訂星期五晚上那家餐廳的位子吧，因為週末總是客滿。
reserve judgment: I will reserve judgment on the new teacher until I have had a few of her classes.
在上過新老師幾堂課之前，我會先保留意見。
reserve the right to: Stores like ours reserve the right to refuse service to anyone who behaves rudely to the staff.
像我們這樣的商店保留拒絕為任何對員工無禮者服務的權利。
reserve one's strength: The runner tried to reserve her strength in the first half of the race so she could sprint at the end.
這名跑者在比賽前半段努力保留體力，好在最後衝刺。
be reserved for: This table is reserved for Mr. Chen, who called this morning to book it for eight o'clock.
這張桌子保留給今天早上打電話預訂八點的陳先生。
in reserve: You should always keep some money in reserve in case of an emergency, like losing your job.
你應該隨時留一些錢備用，以防像失業這樣的緊急狀況。
